question: Identify the odd term with respect to allotropes of carbon.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tungsten**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question identifies the odd term among the given options with respect to allotropes of carbon.
 
• Allotropes are different structural forms of the same element and can display quite different physical properties and chemical behaviors.
 
• Among the options given, Buckminsterfullerene, Graphite, and Diamond are all allotropes of carbon, each with a unique structure.
 
• Tungsten, denoted as option 3, is not an allotrope of carbon but a completely different chemical element with the atomic number 74.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Buckminsterfullerene
 Molecular formula C₆₀, spherical in shape.
 
 

 2) Graphite
 Consists of layers of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal lattice.
 
 

 4) Diamond
 Each carbon atom is bonded to four other carbon atoms in a tetrahedral arrangement, making it extremely hard.
